_note: Customize dialog layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Left panel (menu / lists): x 0 to 1060, centre at 530; right panel (preview): x 1100 to 1920. Colours are AARRGGBB hex strings (COLOR:CreateColorFromHex); opacities and scales are factors (1 = as is). max_w values are the widths a text is fitted into.

background_tile._note: BgTile.png repeated over the screen: columns x rows copies, step_x / step_y apart.

player_art._note: The bottom right corner of the player's picture, before the slide offset.

screen_title._note: A sub-screen's name, centred on menu.cx, below_title px under the title's y.

horizontal_list._note: Character and puchichara lists: visible_count slots slot_w apart around (cx, cy); the item's name sits name_y below its slot, fitted into slot_w less name_padding.

vertical_list._note: Nameplate, dan title, palette and hitsound lists: half_visible rows above and below the selected one, around (cx, cy). Nameplates are plate_w wide and drawn plate_y from their row. Rows other than the selected one are drawn at unselected_opacity.

palette_lock._note: The message under the palette list when the selected palette is locked; y is below the last visible row.

preview._note: The character's bottom and the nameplate's top share base_y, so the nameplate appears right under the character as in game.
